component.name: OnChangeTask
component.script:
' m.inTask is true only in the launched thread's m; render keeps a clone where it stays false. sub init() m.top.functionName = "work" m.inTask = false m.runs = 0 m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("cmd", m.port) end sub
sub onFromRender(event as object) print "ONCHANGE fromRender=" + event.getData().toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() + " port=" + type(m.port) end sub
sub onFromTask(event as object) print "ONCHANGE fromTask=" + event.getData().toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() + " port=" + type(m.port) end sub
sub work() m.inTask = true m.runs++ line = "run " + m.runs.toStr() + ": port=" + type(m.port) if type(m.port) = "roMessagePort" m.top.ready = true msg = wait(2000, m.port) line = line + " event=" + type(msg) m.top.fromTask = 7 end if m.top.report = line end sub
